name: Ashen Tyrant
summary: A hunched giant of cooled ash with five embers in its chest. It guards Gates.

sections.title: Rank and Class
sections.text: A Tyrant: five soul cores, five shards. Its Rank rises with the Gate's Category, from Dormant at Category 1 to Corrupted at Category 5.

sections.title: Habits
sections.text: Ends a Gate as its Guardian. It spawns small copies of itself and drives the creatures around it, and slams the ground to throw back everyone close.

sections.title: Weakness
sections.text: The slam is telegraphed by a raised fist and a held breath: step out of its ring or jump. Kill the lesser copies early to keep the swarm down.

sections.title: Drops
sections.text: Five soul shards of its Rank, and the Gate closes behind it.
